fresh_findings.observation: The Jamie/Alex case changes to a generic 19-sample library. The desktop table foregrounds conversation IDs; no recommended continuation points back to the quality question just demonstrated.
fresh_findings.why_it_matters: A colleague understands the pitch but has to invent a new task and discover a different customer story before learning the prototype.
reproduction: Inspect the first screen and open the billing sample
fresh_findings.proposed_improvement: Add a short landing cue that suggests opening one named sample and explains how that sample relates to the guided quality workflow; prioritize human topic/context over conversation ID in the disconnected list.
fresh_findings.scope_risk: Small public/sample navigation and presentation change; no scoring or provider behavior. Non-blocking for a supervised pilot.

fresh_findings.page_task: Policy author: when will the daily voice policy run?
fresh_findings.observation: The fictional Overview shows daily and weekly scheduled work for the same named policy. Policy collection/detail shows only the weekly schedule and next run.
fresh_findings.why_it_matters: A user can give an incomplete answer about active scheduled work if more than one schedule per policy is a valid authority state.
reproduction: Overview: inspect upcoming daily and weekly entries for Daily Voice Customer Service AQM
Compare Schedule (saved) and Next run with Overview
fresh_findings.proposed_improvement: If multiple schedules are supported, expose all active schedules in policy detail or warn that other schedules exist. If the contract permits only one, enforce/normalize that authority boundary rather than presenting an ambiguous fixture as a normal state.
fresh_findings.scope_risk: Conditional authority/navigation edge; investigate contract after lock. No production schedule was changed. Not a blocker on the single-schedule authoring path.

fresh_findings.page_task: Keyboard quality/Calibration investigation: evaluation result discovery
fresh_findings.observation: After a drill, keyboard traversal to the first evaluation passes 48–49 Tab stops through filters and list controls. The primary row action is reachable with visible focus.
fresh_findings.why_it_matters: A keyboard user pays disproportionate effort to inspect evidence already narrowed by the investigation.
reproduction: Use keyboard to activate Inspect evaluations or Open disagreements
Tab to the first Open evaluation action
fresh_findings.proposed_improvement: Offer an in-page jump to results, or move focus to the result heading/action when entering an exact investigation, preserving access to filters.
fresh_findings.scope_risk: Bounded focus/navigation polish; verify native focus and row return. Non-blocking.

fresh_findings.observation: The product shell footer displays V0.19D SHOWCASE • 2026 even in the current authenticated product.
fresh_findings.why_it_matters: A colleague can reasonably wonder whether the reviewed product is an older showcase build.
reproduction: Explore the prototype or open authenticated Overview
fresh_findings.proposed_improvement: Use product-neutral prototype wording or current release identity in the shell.
fresh_findings.scope_risk: Text-only polish, no product-state behavior; non-blocking.

public_visitor.starting_point: Clean actual public Welcome, 1440×900; repeated clean 390×844
public_visitor.goal: Understand the product and safely explore without connecting
public_visitor.actions: Read hero; guided chapters 1–5 via Next; Exit; calculator cases; Explore; sample detail; Settings connection guidance; fictional authenticated Open AQM separately
public_visitor.result: Pitch comprehensible; safe fictional library and OAuth setup discoverable; disconnected customer context does not survive
public_visitor.wrong_turns: Connect Genesys Cloud in the product breadcrumb was status text, not a button; Settings supplied the actual connection controls. Two automation locator retries are not counted as real user errors.
public_visitor.scrolls: Chapters 2/3/5 and calculator require mobile scrolling to Next/result/exclusions; controls remain reachable.

quality_leader_viewer.starting_point: Fictional VIEWER, connection landing → Open Overview
quality_leader_viewer.goal: Identify attention, weakest quality issue, and supporting evaluations/conversation
quality_leader_viewer.result: Understanding the issue, General Customer Service v17: 33.1% / 8 applicable answers; exact form/question/source/date cohort survives detail/evidence return. Quality and coverage remain separate.
quality_leader_viewer.backtracks: Expected evidence return and browser-history checks
quality_leader_viewer.scrolls: Desktop first scan supplies task areas; mobile passes attention and quality panels. Keyboard 48 tabs from cohort entry to first result.

coverage.starting_point: Analytics Coverage, 20 eligible observations across fictional monitoring runs
coverage.goal: Why were not all eligible conversations evaluated?
coverage.result: 10 deliberately not selected; 4 sampled without usable content; 2 available without completed evaluation; 3 failed attempts clearly distinguished from interaction counts. Repeated run observations and denominator/filter scope disclosed.

reviewer.starting_point: Fictional REVIEWER Overview → My review queue; repeated direct queue at desktop/mobile
reviewer.goal: Complete the most urgent review carefully
reviewer.action_count_definition: Queue, open urgent item, start, two answer selections, question note, overall note, evidence, return, final answer, complete, continue-queue availability; Tab keystrokes are separate. Reproduction/harness retries excluded.
reviewer.result: Escalated item discoverable first; active task separate; two answers and both notes survive explicit evidence return and 1440→390→1440. Full mobile completion succeeds. Completion announces queue removal and independent original AI preservation; in-memory AI records unchanged.
reviewer.confidence: High for supported explicit return; browser exit intentionally guarded and temporary drafts are session-bound
reviewer.wrong_turns: Guessed return label corrected from Back to review to the visible Back to human review. Native select ArrowDown sequence did not commit first answer; keyboard type-ahead worked. These are harness interaction corrections.
reviewer.backtracks: Explicit evidence return; browser exit declined in realistic prior-Welcome reproduction
reviewer.scrolls: Mobile active review auto-focuses workspace; questions and end-of-form finish controls are vertically reachable; queue cards expose action without horizontal action discovery.

reviewer_interruption.result: Two answers (Yes / Needs improvement), question note and overall note retained. Real prior-Welcome browser Back emits beforeunload; dismissing preserves draft. Earlier about:blank Back/Forward exits/reloads disconnected, classified pre-lock as harness context boundary, not unguarded product loss.

author_new_form.scrolls: Library precedes editor; mobile needs substantial vertical travel but native controls and save are reachable.

author_reuse.goal: Create another form reusing existing questions
author_reuse.result: Add reusable group introduces published reusable standards. Resolution & Next Steps adds exactly Ownership, Resolution, Clear next steps. Empty General group remains but no unrelated starter questions appear. Saved fictionally.

author_versioning.goal: Understand what changes before adopting newer reusable standard
author_versioning.result: Resolution clarity v1→v2 comparison names renamed label, credit 100→90%, position changes and new Not applicable answer. policy_author.goal: Identify exact form, selection, next run; protect unsaved edit
policy_author.result: General Customer Service v17, voice condition, 50% sampling, exact published-version pin, schedule timezone/run window and separate save explicit. Native leave confirmation retains unsaved description when declined. Multi-schedule fixture representation is N2.
policy_author.confidence: High for form/selection and guard; conditional for all schedules

calibration.goal: Find largest human/AI disagreement and supporting evaluations
calibration.result: Landing highlights Understanding the issue / General Customer Service v17; 2 of 2 comparable answers disagree, 100%. Exact completed-review/question/source/date drill gives 2 evaluations; evidence/return/browser history preserve scope. Desktop/mobile and keyboard completed.
calibration.scrolls: Mobile results/actions vertically reachable; cohort filters require 49 Tab stops to first evaluation.

admin_settings.goal: Find connection/settings and understand retention/notification effect before change
admin_settings.result: Settings sections separate connection, governance/privacy, notifications and advanced/development. Storage inventory, retention non-destructive-save boundary and dependent-review purge disclosed. Notification routes new operational alerts after scheduler ticks, no backfill. Current section aria-current=location. No writes or destructive actions.
